hadith:
Prostration During Recital of Qur'an - Narrated `Abdullah bin Mas`ud:

The Prophet (ﷺ) recited Suratan-Najm (103) at Mecca and prostrated while reciting it and those who were with him did the same except an old man who took a handful of small stones or earth and lifted it to his forehead and said, "This is sufficient for me." Later on, I saw him killed as a non-believer.
message: Reflect upon the profound truth that Allah is Al Muhsi, the One who meticulously counts every deed and action. Just as He guided the Children of Israel through His revelation to Moses, remember that our own lives are also under divine scrutiny. Let us strive to live righteously, knowing that each act is observed and accounted for.
name:
Al Muhsi - الْمُحْصِي - The All-Enumerating

The name Al Muhsi signifies Allah’s attribute of being fully aware of everything that exists, counting all actions and deeds, ensuring nothing is overlooked. This name emphasizes the concept of accountability in the hereafter, where every action will be recorded and judged. The origin of this name is from the Arabic root 'حَصَرَ' which means to enumerate or count.
verse:
As-Sajdah - The Prostration - 32:23

Indeed, We gave the Scripture to Moses—so let there be no doubt ˹O Prophet˺ that you ˹too˺ are receiving revelations—and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel.
